summary: WIP animation added to Flow view. in_progress nodes get a pulsing blue glow ring (a .fhalo rect behind each card, opacity 0 normally; .wip class via d3 classed toggles @keyframes wippulse — stroke-opacity .12->.95 + width 1.5->4, 1.5s). Edges whose target is in_progress get class .wipedge -> blue marching-ants dashes (@keyframes wipmarch on stroke-dashoffset). Pure CSS keyframes, zero cost when idle, auto start/stop on status change. Verified node --check SYNTAX OK + styles served; demoed live on this very task while it was in_progress.
